pr_title: Publish verified Oyatie API contract surface
summary: Hyperscaler scale review for PR #1: reviewed merged diff metadata and current tree evidence; 2 actionable finding(s), highest severity MAJOR.

findings.issue: The PR shipped a 1070-file bootstrap in one review unit, spanning contracts, crates, docs, registries, and workflows. That defeats facet-local review and makes silent contract drift likely.
findings.remediation: Backfill a machine-readable inventory that groups the PR #1 surface by product/domain/contract and attach per-group verification so later PRs can diff against stable slices.

findings.issue: Large contract surface landed before a per-endpoint/accounted inventory existed. Review cannot prove every endpoint/schema has an owner, data-class, auth posture, and generated binding.
findings.remediation: Generate/validate endpoint and schema inventory from the current tree and register missing owner/data-class/auth rows as bounded FixupTasks.
